scientific_integrity.computational_scope: All 967 nonempty simplices and all ten graph automorphisms, with exact modular linear algebra and signed action.
scientific_integrity.proof_method: Complete signed simplicial-chain enumeration, boundary-rank bracketing, equivariant Lefschetz calculation and rational character comparison.

scientific_limitations: The statement concerns rational homology of one explicitly defined eleven-vertex graph under its dihedral automorphism group.
It does not determine integral representation lattices, equivariant homotopy types, or integral orbit-space homology.
Publication priority is not definitive; equivalent unindexed work could exist.
title: Complete rational dihedral character of the Grötzsch matching complex
